standard_roles.title: Executive Sponsor
standard_roles.description: Accountable for business outcomes, budget allocation, and executive escalation.

standard_roles.title: Migration Programme Manager
standard_roles.description: Drives project execution, timeline, critical path, cross-functional coordination, and reporting.

standard_roles.title: Lead Cloud Architect
standard_roles.description: Owns target Azure Landing Zone design, 6R disposition decisions, and technical governance.

standard_roles.title: Infrastructure / Migration Engineer
standard_roles.description: Performs server replication, testing, cutover execution, and post-migration validation.

standard_roles.title: Security & Compliance Lead
standard_roles.description: Validates identity, RBAC, encryption, Key Vault, and compliance controls per spoke.

standard_roles.title: Network Engineer
standard_roles.description: Manages ExpressRoute/VPN, hub-spoke routing, IP allocation, DNS, and firewall rules.

standard_roles.title: Database Administrator (DBA)
standard_roles.description: Oversees database replatforming, data synchronization, backup, and cutover integrity.

standard_roles.title: Application Owner / SME
standard_roles.description: Signs off on application disposition, testing criteria, cutover window, and business acceptance.

standard_roles.title: DevOps & Operations Lead
standard_roles.description: Integrates CI/CD, monitoring, Log Analytics, backup policies, and support handoff.
